defect.problem: The black-letter rule includes a verbatim Knotts quote and page-specific support that cannot be verified from the disclosed evidence. No text/Knotts file is present, lake pin-281 is slip-only with quote_fidelity=mismatch, and the asserted quotation does not appear in the disclosed Knotts pinpoints. The Carpenter prong is also broader than the disclosed holding unless limited to historical CSLI.
defect.proposed_fix: Remove the Knotts quotation marks or replace the quote with a disclosed verified quote; if retaining the 281 quotation, add faithful opinion text or a corrected lake pinpoint. Narrow prong (3) to acquisition of historical CSLI that chronicles past movements.

reasons: Knotts pin-281 supports the no-search public-road beeper proposition only as a slip-only generated issue/rule entry, not as the asserted verbatim quotation.

The only Knotts pinpoint marked star-verified/matched is pin-282, which says: "Nothing in the Fourth Amendment prohibited the police from augmenting the sensory faculties bestowed upon them at birth with such enhancement as science and technology afforded them in this case."

Carpenter's disclosed lake support is historical cell-site records that chronicle past movements; a general comprehensive-record tracking rule needs that historical-CSLI limitation to avoid overclaim.
residual_risks: No text/*.txt opinion files were disclosed, so exact quote fidelity and page landing cannot be independently checked.
Most component propositions are directionally supported by lake pinpoints, but the black-letter formulation cannot stand as written under the disclosed-evidence rule.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Use paraphrase for Knotts unless a faithful text source is supplied, cite Karo pin-715 for the interior-fact wording, and phrase Carpenter as historical CSLI only.
